detail: EU/EEA nationals do not need a visa or work permit. Non-EU/EEA students generally need an entry visa (MVV) and/or a residence permit (VVR). Your university acts as your official sponsor and usually submits the immigration application for you.

provenance.source: Study in NL - Do you need a visa?

detail: For student immigration, the recognised sponsor is your university. They file the MVV/VVR application with the IND on your behalf. You do not need a private agency to lodge the immigration application, and no agency can 'guarantee' a visa.

provenance.source: Study in NL - Plan your stay

topic: Proof of funds for the visa
detail: You must show about €1,130 per month for 12 months (roughly €13,569) as available funds, on top of unpaid tuition. This is money you must demonstrate you have; it is not paid to the university or an agent.

provenance.source: Dutch immigration service (IND) - income requirements for study
